card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as coordinates, times, page ranges, case citations, DOIs and dose tables. The digit is followed by more digits.

modes.label: Coordinates and times
modes.description: A middle digit in degrees, minutes, seconds or clock times.

modes.label: Citations and identifiers
modes.description: A middle digit in page numbers, case citations or DOIs.

modes.label: Dose and lab numbers
modes.description: A middle digit in dose or activity values in tables.
modes.example: Second dose reduction 3<<0>>0 mg taken orally twice daily Discontinue
